title: Filipino Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from the Philippines, featuring tender beef and a rich, slightly sweet sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove beef from pot and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add fish sauce, brown sugar, bay leaves, black pepper, and salt. Stir to combine.
Return beef to pot and add enough water to cover.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh bay leaves if desired.
